title: Aaron Rodgers goes off on ‘criminal’ Anthony Fauci in angry ESPN rant: ‘What are you scared of, Tony?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Rodgers goes off on ‘criminal’ Anthony Fauci in angry ESPN rant: ‘What are you scared of, Tony?
sources.description: Aaron Rodgers didn't hold back while discussing Dr. Anthony Fauci, who repeatedly invoked the Fifth Amendment regarding questions on COVID-19 and the government’s pandemic response in a Senate committee hearing on Wednesday.
